One of the best European style coffees we had in Vietnam
Dec 2025 • Couples
I really missed a traditional cappuccino, so we went looking and end up in this place. Ordered one cappuccino and one latter, with a chocolate cake. One of the best European style coffees we had in Vietnam so far! Both drinks made with arabica beans, and ice cream for the cake - truly delicious. Service was also very nice, barista was friendly and spoke good English. Lovely atmosphere, too bad we discovered it on our last day in Ninh Binh, otherwise we would definitely come back.

Best coffee and breakfast in Tam Coc!
Oct 2025 • Couples

Highly recommended!
